Looking To The Future rendered in a scratch copy of the SWCCG Card Maker (Bardez Light Side Effect frame, text drawn by the Card Maker, art window cut from [[:File:RG-GEMP-Looking-To-The-Future.png]]) with the remastered gold coin, cut from [[:File:RG-GEMP-Looking-To-The-Future.png]]. Delete when the test is finished.
